name: Stormbuddy
summary: App Store listing for an iPhone app roofing and storm restoration crews use to run leads, jobs, canvassing and invoices from the field.
description: StormBuddi is the mobile companion for roofing and storm restoration professionals: a dashboard of leads, jobs, appointments and storm alerts, plus customer records, hail canvassing, inspections and invoicing. Free with in-app purchases, rated 4+, Business category, 37.5 MB, iPhone only, English.
